verdict.rationale: Teller is a banking-data API platform with client SDKs such as Teller Connect, so telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The sandbox environment and mTLS authentication items are about other capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
